investigate_data_discrepancy.description: Investigate API vs DB count discrepancy caused by temporal filtering

investigate_data_discrepancy.note: DATA_GAPS_INVESTIGATION_2026_01_15.md found: Report shows 123 meetings but API returns 3. Hypothesis: records exist in DB but are filtered out by valid_from/valid_to constraints in PostgresBackend.get_meetings() and related methods. May be bug in insertion timestamps or intentional behavior not accounted for.
investigation_steps: Query DB directly: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetings WHERE jurisdiction_id = 'city-san-rafael'
Check valid_from/valid_to values: SELECT valid_from, valid_to, COUNT(*) FROM meetings GROUP BY valid_from, valid_to
Compare with API: PostgresBackend.get_meetings() with temporal filter
Determine if filtering is bug or intentional
